12:23.text: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him
, and she closed the doors and said: "Come on, O you." He said: "I seek refuge in Allâh
is my master! He made my living in a great comfort!

12:24.text: And indeed she did desire him, and he would have inclined to her desire, had he not seen the evidence of his Lord. Thus it was, that We might turn away from him evil and illegal sexual intercourse. Surely, he was one of Our chosen

12:25.text: So they raced with one another to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back. They both found her lord
at the door. She said: "What is the recompense
for him who intended an evil design against your wife, except that he be put in prison or a painful torment?"

12:26.text: said: "It was she that sought to seduce me;" and a witness of her household bore witness
: "If it be that his shirt is torn from the front, then her tale is true and he is a liar!

12:27.text: "But if it be that his shirt is torn from the back, then she has told a lie and he is speaking the truth!"

12:28.text: shirt torn at the back, he
said: "Surely, it is a plot of you women! Certainly mighty is your plot!

12:29.text: Ask forgiveness for your sin. Verily, you were of the sinful."

12:30.text: And women in the city said: "The wife of Al-‘Azîz is seeking to seduce her
young man, indeed she loves him violently; verily we see her in plain error."
